_about: Source for the built-in Cookbook. Run: python3 tools/build_cookbook.py  → data/cookbook.json. Each ingredient: name, amt + u (shown, scaled), g (grams for nutrition), fid (food id in the built-in database) or n ([kcal, protein, carbs, fat, fibre] per 100 g). Raise rev when a recipe changes so phones that have not edited it get the new version. sec = step timer in seconds.

recipes.name: Fluffy protein banana chocolate cake
recipes.desc: Soft banana-chocolate cake in an Auflauf form. Whipped egg whites make it fluffy, crème fraîche keeps the whey from drying it out, and it has very little added sugar.

ing.name: Sugar (half for the yolks, half for the whites)

steps.c: Heat the oven to 170 °C Ober-/Unterhitze (150 °C Umluft). Grease the form or line it with baking paper.
Mash the bananas until smooth. Whisk in the egg yolks, crème fraîche, milk, melted butter, Vanillezucker and half of the sugar until creamy.
In a second bowl mix the whey, flour, Backkakao, Backpulver and salt. Sift the cocoa if it is lumpy. Fold into the wet mix until just combined. The batter is thick; don't overmix.
Beat the egg whites with the rest of the sugar to stiff peaks. This is what makes it fluffy.
Stir a third of the whites into the batter to loosen it, then gently fold in the rest in two goes. Fold in about three quarters of the chocolate.

Spread into the form and scatter the rest of the chocolate on top. Bake 25–30 min, until a skewer comes out with a few moist crumbs. Whey dries out fast: check at 25 min, and cover loosely with foil if the top browns too quickly.
Let it cool in the form for at least 20 min before cutting. It firms up as it cools.

recipes.notes: No crème fraîche? Use about 120 ml Schlagsahne instead of the crème fraîche and milk. Leaner: swap 100 g crème fraîche for Skyr or Magerquark. Best slightly warm, with unsweetened whipped Schlagsahne and a pinch of flaky salt on top. Not sweet enough? Add 15–20 g sugar or a drizzle of honey next time. Brownie style: don't separate the eggs and bake about 20 min.

recipes.name: Protein muffins (Rührteig)
recipes.desc: Classic German Rührteig muffins with a quarter of the flour swapped for whey and less sugar. Full butter and extra milk keep them moist.

steps.c: Heat the oven to 175 °C Ober-/Unterhitze (155 °C Umluft). Put paper cases in the muffin tin.
Beat the soft butter with the sugar and Vanillezucker for 2–3 min until pale and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time.
Mix the flour, whey, Backpulver and salt.

Stir the dry mix into the butter mix in two goes, alternating with the milk, only until combined. The batter should be soft and almost pourable, looser than a normal Rührteig; add another tbsp of milk if it is stiff. Let it rest 5 min so the whey can soak up the liquid.
Fill the cases about two thirds full. Bake about 18 min, until a toothpick comes out barely clean. Don't overbake: whey makes them dry.
Leave 5 min in the tin, then cool on a rack.

recipes.notes: With vanilla whey: use 70–80 g sugar and leave out the Vanillezucker. Never swap more than about a third of the flour for whey, or they turn dry and spongy. Add-ins that work: chopped dark chocolate, blueberries, a mashed banana (then 2 tbsp less milk).
